method: Real preview app sign-in with existing synthetic account; ordinary same-origin issuance. One restricted-bearer TUS POST declared512 bytes and sent no body. Sequential HEAD with live upload bearer, no bearer, and public anonymous bearer. Finally exact live-bearer TUS DELETE and HEAD. No PATCH, file selection, finalization or preparation.

interpretation.authorization: Public anonymous bearer returned offset and declared length for the known upload URL without account/session/subject/consent authority. Missing bearer was rejected; this is not unauthenticated JWT bypass.
interpretation.termination: 204 then404 confirm protocol termination only. Physical backend inventory was unavailable; do not infer all provider-side records/fragments were physically purged.
interpretation.capacity: No source bytes, complete transfer, finalization, preparation or increased capacity was measured.

databaseObservation.caveat: S3 protocol rows are not an inventory of physical TUS uploads. Upload authority row remains until ordinary retention handles it; no metadata cleanup was forced.

laterRetentionObservation.caveat: App retention phase remained pending past deadline for this empty probe. No source bytes were sent; no physical backend inventory or scheduler cause was established. Cleanup was not forced.
